target: fatal accidents involving Boeing commercial jets

evidence.observation: CAAC identifies the 21 March 2022 MU5735 occurrence as an aviation accident involving Boeing 737-800 B-1791 on the Kunming-Guangzhou passenger flight and records 123 passengers plus nine crew fatalities.

IATA reports five fatal accidents in 2022: one jet and four turboprop, with 158 onboard fatalities. Its accident update identifies the single fatal jet as China Eastern Airlines B737-800 MU5735 with 132 onboard fatalities.
evidence.use: annual fatal-jet universe and membership reconciliation

evidence.authority_role: manufacturer statistical publisher; public copy hosted by the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration
evidence.source_title: 2022 Statistical Summary of Commercial Jet Airplane Accidents — Worldwide Operations 1959-2022
evidence.scope: worldwide commercial jet fleet under Boeing definitions
evidence.observation: Boeing does not list MU5735 because its definitions exclude events categorized UNK pending an official Annex 13 determination. Its 2022 airplane-accident table separately reports five external fatalities, all in non-Boeing events: TAP A320neo (2), LATAM A320neo (2) and Envoy E175 (1). Thus no additional Boeing external-fatality-only target case is hidden by IATA's onboard-fatality metric.
evidence.use: independent reconciliation, source-scope rule and external-fatality control

scope_issue.reason: Boeing's statistical omission follows its documented UNK rule. CAAC, the competent state authority, identifies the occurrence as an aviation accident involving a commercial Boeing 737-800. BSFM target membership is therefore not defined by Boeing's publication-time statistical inclusion rule; the discrepancy is retained as source-scope metadata.

completeness_assessment.reason: IATA establishes a single fatal jet accident in 2022 and identifies it as MU5735. CAAC supplies competent-authority Boeing accident evidence. Boeing's table provides an independent external-fatality check showing that all five external deaths in its 2022 universe occurred in non-Boeing aircraft, while its MU5735 omission is explained by a documented source-specific UNK rule.

gate_effect: 2022 annual cell PASS; overall G1 remains BLOCKED until every required annual cell passes
